product.title: Tallest in Utah Via Ferrata & Rappelling

description.text: Climb Utah's tallest via ferrata route at East Zion's Top of the Rock, then descend through a canyoneering section with guided rappels into sandstone slots. Certified guides fit your harness and helmet, lead you up fixed cable pitches and iron ladder sections, and coach first-time via ferrata climbers through each exposed ledge. The four-hour outing combines summit panoramas over the eastern plateau with adrenaline rappelling outside the crowded Zion Canyon shuttle zone. Technical gear and safety instruction are included for a complete half-day adventure.

highlights: Utah's tallest via ferrata with iron ladder sections
Top of the Rock summit panoramas over East Zion
Guided canyoneering traverse and rappel descents
Harness, helmet, and technical gear included
Instruction for first-time via ferrata climbers

start.description: Check in at East Zion Resort, 859 Zion Park Blvd, Orderville, UT 84758. Arrive 15 minutes before your scheduled departure.

end.description: Return to East Zion Resort after the final rappel and gear return.
